id: 680-第九次「星際大戰」（第五次卡拉科爾-納蘭霍戰爭)）
theater: 瓦卡台地南緣與查基布爾河谷

battle.name: 第九次「星際大戰」（第五次卡拉科爾-納蘭霍戰爭)）
battle.theater: 瓦卡台地南緣與查基布爾河谷
battle.brief: 公元六八○年冬，科潘河谷納蘭霍在六三六年焚城之後重新立國，首次自己站到進攻位置：聯軍沿查基布爾古道翻上瓦卡台地，攻入卡拉科爾「天宮」一線，焚其倉房、奪其玉座與偶像，把六三六年欠下的星戰義務一次清掉。科林斯青銅盔從未現於中美洲，它在此標示「看不見左右、只能靠隊形活」的裝束難題。

kit.name: 科林斯青銅盔
kit.history: 全正面開眼的青銅盔。看得見的代價是：戴它的人只能靠隊形活。

countries: 這場戰爭發生在瑪雅古典期晚段的低地城邦體系裡，交戰的兩方都是獨立的城邦政治體，沒有宣戰程序，也沒有常備國軍，只有各城按聯盟義務臨時徵集的戰士。進攻方是洪都拉斯科潘河谷的納蘭霍（Naranj Ha）：六三六年被卡拉科爾焚城之後它淪為附庸，卻在七世紀的重建中靠著王統未絕、村社重編與卡拉克穆爾的撫持，一點一點積回兵源與盟約，到六八○年冬重新站到進攻的位置上。聯軍以納蘭霍的佩槍貴族菁英為骨幹，配擲矛器手、弓手與投石手，另有科潘河谷的村社兵、多斯皮拉斯與烏克薩克通方向的外援，以及一批對卡拉科爾關稅不滿的前附庸倒戈。防守方是貝里斯凱奧區、瓦卡台地上的卡拉科爾（Uxwitza'），核心建築群以「天宮」Caana 與主廣場四周的高層台基為中心，兵員由王畿村落的常備與民兵抽調，骨幹同樣是佩槍菁英，另有擲矛器手、弓手、投石手，以及商路守軍與黑曜石產區的徵發隊。第三方是卡拉克穆爾、蒂卡爾與科潘，三城各有自己的算盤，但都在這一場裡調整了站位。
countriesEn: This war was fought inside the system of lowland Maya city-states in the late Classic period, and both belligerents were independent city-state polities with no declaration of war and no standing national army, only warriors levied for the occasion according to alliance obligation. The attacker was Naranjo, called Naranj Ha, in the Copan valley of Honduras: after Caracol burned it in 636 it had been reduced to a client, yet through the reconstruction of the seventh century, with an unbroken royal line, a reorganisation of the villages and the patronage of Calakmul, it slowly rebuilt a body of men and a web of alliances, and by the winter of 680 had once again taken up the attacking position. The coalition had at its core the spearmen elite of Naranjo, backed by dart throwers, archers and slingers, and further drew on village levies from the Copan valley, reinforcements coming by way of Dos Pilas and Uaxactun, and a body of former clients who had turned against Caracol over its tolls. The defender was Caracol, called Uxwitza', in the Cayo District of Belize on the Vaca Plateau, its core building group centred on the Caana and the high temple platforms around the main plaza; its men were drawn from the standing levies and the militia of the villages round the capital, the backbone again being the spearmen elite, with dart throwers, archers and slingers, besides the road guards and the levy from the obsidian producing districts. Third parties were Calakmul, Tikal and Copan, each with its own arithmetic, and each of them shifted position in the course of this war.
people: 能點名的人不多，留下痕跡的多半是碑刻與墓葬。進攻方納蘭霍一側，現存可完整讀出的君王名號要晚到七一○年之後的三十號碑一系，本役的君主只能從伊察姆坎王朝的世系推想，學界通常把六八○年的統治者放在 K'an Ahil Mex（碑銘作 K'an Ahil Mex Tuun Yohl K'inich，漢譯「玉面」）一系；可以確定的是，他必須在六八○年冬主持宣誓與定日，並在城前把對方君主或其攝政擒下。防守方卡拉科爾的王「鷹豹」K'inich Yax K'uk' Mo' 正是六三六年焚城的主帥，一九八五年出土的 B-37 號墓以護目符神面式樣的戰盾與隨葬的年輕戰士骨骼，被認定為他的陵墓；至六八○年他是否仍在位已無從確定，碑銘只說那一戰之後王統換了名號。除了兩位君主，還有大批不留姓名的人：依金星曆算定出征日的祭司、抄寫戰果並把「零」刻上碑面的書記、率突擊隊上梯的貴族隊長、戴戰神面具出戰的菁英、處理俘虜贖金的中人，以及背運玉米與繩梯的勞役隊。
peopleEn: Few individuals can be named, and most of those who left a trace did so in inscriptions and tombs. On the Naranjo side, the only royal names that can be read in full come from the Stela 30 series after 710, so the ruler of this campaign can only be inferred from the line of the Itz'am K'an dynasty; scholarship usually places the ruler of 680 in the line of K'an Ahil Mex, written on the monuments as K'an Ahil Mex Tuun Yohl K'inich and rendered in Chinese as Jade Face. What can be established is that he had to preside over the oath-taking and the fixing of the day in the winter of 680, and to take the opposing lord or his regent alive before the city. On the Caracol side the Owl Jaguar, K'inich Yax K'uk' Mo', had been the commander who burned Naranjo in 636; tomb B-37, excavated in 1985, with its war shield bearing the goggle-eyed deity mask and the bones of a young warrior buried with the lord, has been identified as his burial. Whether he was still on the throne in 680 cannot be established; the inscriptions say only that the royal name changed after that battle. Around them stand a great many who left no name: the priests who fixed the day of the march by the phases of Venus, the scribes who wrote down the result and cut the zero onto the monument, the noble captains who led the ladders in the assault, the elite who fought wearing the masks of the war god, the middlemen who handled the ransom of captives, and the porters who carried maize and rope ladders behind the army.
kits: 卡面所列的科林斯青銅盔（Corinthian helmet，約公元前六五○年，希臘）沒有出現在公元六八○年的中美洲：青銅冶煉與地中海的盔式從未越過大西洋，這頂全正面開眼、只留兩道窄縫的銅盔不是本役的實物裝備。它在戰役裡真正對應的位置，是納蘭霍與卡拉科爾菁英頭上的獸皮與硬木頭套，以及用青玉與貝殼拼貼的戰神面具——同樣把眼睛框在狹縫裡，戴上之後看不見左右，只能靠身旁的隊形活命。瑪雅戰場實際的裝備分五層。第一層近戰：鑲黑曜石片的木柄棍劍 macuahuitl、石斧、木矛。第二層投射：擲矛器 atlatl 配加重前端的細長木矛、短弓與箭、石彈投石索。第三層防護：夾層棉甲 ichcahuipilli 配獸皮、木框蒙皮綴羽的圓盾 chictli 與綴石的小方盾 tecpatl。第四層攻城：木梯、繩索、破門斧與火攻草束，瑪雅建築多為木構茅頂，一經點燃便難以撲救。第五層後勤：沒有馭獸，糧秣、矛束與繩梯全靠人背，渡科潘河與烏拉河改用獨木舟，主食是玉米、豆類、南瓜與鹹魚，可可作儀式交換。卡面那句「看得見的代價是：戴它的人只能靠隊形活」，在本役正是交鋒的關鍵：戴上面具的突擊隊看不見左右，守軍卻以圓盾結成一條完整的正面，把來軍一段一段推回去。
kitsEn: The Corinthian helmet named on the card (Corinthian helmet, about 650 BC, Greek) did not appear in Middle America in the year 680: bronze smelting and Mediterranean helmet forms never crossed the Atlantic, and this full-face bronze helm with its two narrow eye slits is not an actual piece of equipment from this campaign. What it does correspond to in the war is the hide and hardwood headgear of the Naranjo and Caracol elite, and the masks of the war god pieced together from jade and shell, which likewise boxed the eyes into narrow slits: once they were on, a man could not see to his left or right and could only stay alive through the shape of the men beside him. The equipment actually present on a Maya battlefield falls into five layers. First, close combat: the macuahuitl, a wooden club with obsidian blades set into the handle, stone axes and wooden spears. Second, missiles: the atlatl with its weighted slender dart, short bows and arrows, and stone-weighted throwing cords. Third, protection: the layered cotton armour ichcahuipilli worn over a hide, the round hide-framed feather-trimmed shield chictli, and the small square shield studded with stone, the tecpatl. Fourth, siege: wooden ladders, rope, axes for breaking doors and bundles of burning thatch, since Maya buildings were timber-framed with thatched roofs and once lit could hardly be saved. Fifth, logistics: there were no draft animals, so grain, dart bundles and rope ladders all travelled on human backs, the Copan and Ulua rivers were crossed in canoes, the staple food was maize, beans, squash and salted fish, and cacao served ritual exchange. The line on the card, that the price of sight is that the wearer can only live by the formation, was exactly what the engagement turned on: the masked assault companies could not see sideways, while the defenders closed into a continuous front of round shields and pushed the attackers back by inches.
tactics: 瑪雅的「星戰」是一場被星辰指定義務的攻擊：誓師要挑日子，出兵要挑旱季，攻入城後須俘獲對方君主或貴族、焚其偶像，再把「零」刻在碑上宣告對方被抹去。本役的行程是這樣的：納蘭霍聯軍自科潘河谷出發，沿查基布爾商路西北上行，經貝里斯山脈東麓的溪谷翻上瓦卡台地南緣，遠征隊只能輕裝先鋒在前、糧秣隊與俘虜隊在後，全程沒有可供車馬通行的寬路，缺水與連日行軍是最大負擔；接戰在台地南緣的梯田與通往 Caana 的主階一帶展開。攻方先以擲矛手在數十步外排成散兵線齊射，弓手分佔兩翼，佩槍手以圓盾相接頂住守軍的躍前突擊，接近後改用木劍與石斧貼身廝殺，戴戰神面具的突擊隊走在最前。攻城時先斷田禾與水源，再點燃倉房，最後以梯與繩索攀上台地。火起之後戴面具的突擊隊在煙霧與火光中失去方向，守軍則在主階前以圓盾結成一條完整正面，把來軍一段一段推回去——輸贏不在誰的兵器更利，而在誰的隊形沒有散。
tacticsEn: A Maya star war was an attack carrying an obligation assigned by the stars: the oath had to be sworn on a chosen day, the host had to be raised in the dry season, and once inside the enemy city the attackers had to take the opposing lord or his nobles alive, burn his effigies, and then cut a zero onto the monument to declare the enemy unmade. The shape of this campaign was as follows. The Naranjo coalition set out from the Copan valley, moved north-west along the Chiquibul trade road, climbed through the streams along the eastern foot of the Maya Mountains and up onto the southern rim of the Vaca Plateau; there was no broad track anywhere for carts or horses, so the expedition could only travel with a light vanguard in front and the grain train and the column of captives behind, and the shortage of water and days of walking were the heaviest burden. Contact was made on the terraces at the southern edge of the plateau and on the main stair leading up to the Caana. The attackers opened with dart throwers firing in loose order from several dozen paces, archers took the flanks, spearmen locked shields together against the leaping assault of the defenders, and at close quarters they fought with wooden swords and stone axes, the masked companies of the war god walking at the head. In the assault they first cut crops and water, then fired the storehouses, and only at the end climbed the terraces with ladders and rope. Once the granaries were burning, the masked assault lost its bearings in the smoke and the firelight, while the defenders closed into one continuous front of round shields on the main stair and pushed the attackers back by inches. The outcome did not turn on who had the sharper weapons but on whose formation held.
data: 可引的數字集中在幾處。地理上，卡拉科爾在北緯十六度四十五分五十秒、西經八十九度七分三秒，海拔約五百公尺，遺址範圍約二百平方公里，考古計畫自一九八五年起發掘，二〇一○年五月公布的機載雷射測繪一次掃出周邊二百平方公里；納蘭霍在科潘河谷內，約北緯十四度五十五分、西經八十九度九分。兩地直線相距約二百公里，循查基布爾古道繞行接近三百公里，遠征隊連同糧秣隊一般要走十至十四日才能抵達城下。整批星戰銘文共記十三場，橫跨五六二至七八一年，時間集中在十一月至翌年一月的乾季，九月中至十月下旬的收穫期完全沒有記錄，本役月份據此置於十二月，屬約數。遠征兵力沒有可靠數字，學界對這類星戰給出的寬鬆區間在數千名戰士之間，其中佩槍的貴族菁英通常只有數十至數百人。納蘭霍三十號碑所記的君王名號、三十二號碑的斬首圖像與三十三號碑被磨去的碑文，是本役最直接的物質記錄。損耗數字沒有來源可以支撐，只宜說兩城各有相當數量的建築被焚、村社人口外流。
dataEn: The figures that can be cited fall into a few groups. In geography, Caracol stands at 16 degrees 45 minutes 50 seconds north, 89 degrees 7 minutes 3 seconds west, at an elevation of about 500 metres, and the site covers roughly 200 square kilometres; the archaeological project has been excavating there since 1985, and the airborne laser survey flown in the spring of 2009 and published in May 2010 swept some 200 square kilometres of the surroundings in a single pass. Naranjo lies inside the Copan valley at about 14 degrees 55 minutes north, 89 degrees 9 minutes west. The two sites are roughly 200 kilometres apart in a straight line and rather close to 300 kilometres if the Chiquibul road is followed, so an expedition with its grain train generally needed ten to fourteen days to reach the enemy walls. The whole corpus of star war inscriptions records thirteen engagements spread across 562 to 781, concentrated in the dry season from November into January, with no record at all in the harvest window from mid-September to late October; the month given for this war follows that pattern and is an approximation, placed in December. There is no reliable figure for the size of the host, and scholarship puts such star wars in the loose range of several thousand warriors, of whom the spearmen elite was usually only some dozens to some hundreds. The royal names on Naranjo Stela 30, the decapitation carved on Stela 32 and the deliberately erased text of Stela 33 are the most direct material trace of this campaign. As for losses, no source supports any number, and the only safe statement is that substantial numbers of buildings in both cities were burned and that population moved out of the villages.
cause: 打起來有幾層原因，最表面的是六三六年那場欠下的賬。六三六年卡拉科爾在科潘河谷焚了納蘭霍，擒走並焚殺其君主，毀其偶像而未走完儀式——按瑪雅的星戰義務，這筆賬要由一場更大的星戰清償，而清算的方式通常是反過來：奪走對方的君主與神像。往下一層是走廊霸權。卡拉科爾自五六二年擊敗蒂卡爾之後控制了貝里斯—洪都拉斯走廊，查基布爾商路上的鹽、黑曜石、翡翠、可可與棉花構成這條線的交換骨架，山口與渡口誰控誰抽稅；納蘭霍復國後要在科潘河谷站穩，就必須先切斷這條線。再下一層是聯盟的整體傾斜：七○年代多斯皮拉斯在佩滕重新坐大、卡拉克穆爾的護持轉弱，納蘭霍發現自己不再是任何強權的附庸，而蒂卡爾—多斯皮拉斯一系也需要一個能牽制貝里斯山脈的南方支點。還有一層是儀式：王權需要一次完滿的星戰來確認正統，把對手從宇宙秩序裡抹去；對方越是把六三六年的勝利寫成神話，這一場敗績就越不能容忍。
causeEn: There were several layers of reason behind the fighting, the outermost being the account left over from 636. In 636 Caracol burned Naranjo in the Copan valley, took its lord alive and burned him, destroyed his effigies and left the rite unfinished; under the obligations of a Maya star war such an account has to be settled by a greater star war, and the usual way of settling it is in reverse: to take the opponent's lord and his god-images away. One level deeper lies the struggle over the corridor. Since beating Tikal in 562, Caracol had controlled the Belize-Honduras corridor, and the salt, obsidian, jade, cacao and cotton of the Chiquibul road formed the exchange skeleton of that line, with whoever holding the passes and the fords collecting the tolls; for Naranjo to re-establish itself in the Copan valley it first had to cut that line. One level deeper again is the general tilt of the alliance system: in the 670s Dos Pilas reasserted itself in the Peten and Calakmul's patronage weakened, Naranjo found that it was no longer the client of any great power, while the Tikal-Dos Pilas camp needed a southern pillar able to tie down the Maya Mountains. Last of all comes the ritual layer: kingship needs a star war complete in its terms to confirm its legitimacy and to rub the enemy out of the order of the world; the more the opponent wrote the victory of 636 up as myth, the less tolerable a defeat at its hands could be.
impact: 直接效果是東南低地權力版圖的一次反轉。六三六年之後被記作「再未恢復六世紀規模」的納蘭霍，在六八○年之後重新立起自己的碑刻：科潘河谷各村社改向它繳納供奉，貝里斯山脈東麓的商路稅源一度北移到納蘭霍一方，貝里斯—洪都拉斯走廊第一次不再由卡拉科爾一家說了算。卡拉科爾的代價則集中在王權的正當性上：天宮一線的高層建築群受損，六三六年焚城時被奪走的儀式位置被對方以牙還牙地取回，連帶它在佩滕的代理網絡與黑曜石徵發線都受牽動。這一仗也是後來連鎖崩解的第一步：納蘭霍與蒂卡爾—多斯皮拉斯—烏克薩克通的聯盟在七三○年代成型，七三六年前後賈索·錢·卡維爾一世率聯盟攻破卡拉科爾，一座延續數百年的城邦自此崩解，九世紀完全廢棄。長期看，星戰的邏輯在此閉合得更完整：摧毀別人的城邦者，最後往往等來自己的墳場；六三六年贏下走廊的卡拉科爾，四十四年後在自己城門前嘗到同一種滋味。
impactEn: The immediate effect was a reversal in the power map of the southeastern lowlands. Naranjo, which after 636 had been recorded as never recovering its sixth-century scale, set up its own monuments again after 680: the villages of the Copan valley turned their tribute to it, the tolls of the trade road along the eastern foot of the Maya Mountains shifted for a time to the Naranjo side, and the Belize-Honduras corridor was no longer spoken for by Caracol alone. Caracol's cost fell on the legitimacy of its kingship: the high building group of the Caana was damaged, the ritual position seized in the burning of 636 was taken back by the other side tooth for tooth, and its agency network in the Peten and its obsidian levy lines were affected in turn. This war was also the first step in the chain of collapses that followed: the alliance of Naranjo with Tikal, Dos Pilas and Uaxactun took shape in the 730s, and around 736 Jasaw Chan K'awiil I led that coalition against Caracol, and a city of several centuries' standing came apart and was finally abandoned in the ninth century. In the long run the logic of the star war closes here more completely than anywhere else: the destroyer of another city-state is often met by his own grave; Caracol, which had won the corridor in 636, tasted the same thing before its own gates forty-four years later.
result: 就現有材料可判斷的方向看，這一仗以納蘭霍的星戰成功告一段落。遠征隊沿查基布爾古道打到瓦卡台地南緣，攻入 Caana 一帶的台基區，焚毀倉房與神殿、奪走對方君主的偶像與玉座，把「零」刻在納蘭霍的碑上；卡拉科爾靠台地階梯與圓盾正面守住了核心區未被整體攻破，但已失去南翼的商路與附庸網絡，城邦從此淪為北面聯盟的目標與附庸。對納蘭霍而言，這場勝利是六三六年之後第一次把星戰的義務走完：俘獲、焚像、立碑、贖俘，四十四年的帳一次清掉；對卡拉科爾而言，這是一場不致命的重傷——城未破、王未擒，卻丟了走廊的霸權與「鷹豹」一系的神話。餘波仍然很長：七○五年多斯皮拉斯攻破蒂卡爾、七三六年賈索·錢·卡維爾一世滅卡拉克穆爾與卡拉科爾、七三八年納蘭霍王入主科潘，六八○年這場戰爭是這串倒轉的起頭，也是「星際大戰」序列裡第九次被記下名字的一次。
resultEn: On what the surviving material allows us to judge, this war ended with the star war of Naranjo a success. The expedition fought its way up the Chiquibul road to the southern rim of the Vaca Plateau, broke into the platform zone around the Caana, burned the storehouses and the temples, took away the lord's effigies and his jade seat, and cut a zero onto the Naranjo monument; Caracol, holding the terraces and the front of round shields, kept the core of the city from being taken altogether, but had already lost the road and the client network on its southern flank, and the city-state henceforth existed as a target and a client of the alliance to the north. For Naranjo this was the first time since 636 that the obligations of the star war had been carried through to the end: the capture, the burning of the images, the raising of the monument, the ransoming of the prisoners, forty-four years of account settled in one stroke. For Caracol it was a wound that was not mortal: the city was not taken and the king was not captured, yet the mastery of the corridor and the myth of the Owl Jaguar line were both lost. The aftershocks ran long: in 705 Dos Pilas broke Tikal, in 736 Jasaw Chan K'awiil I destroyed Calakmul and Caracol, and in 738 the king of Naranjo moved to Copan. The war of 680 is the beginning of that reversal, and the ninth of the engagements to be given a name in the sequence of the star wars.
